page.layout: One page of text, full width: a dedication title block at the top, then a paragraph opening with a woodcut initial and running to the foot. Signature mark at the bottom left.

main_text.head: Nobilissimis & Amplissimis Dominis, D. PAULO VOET van WINSSEN, JCto, Supremi Foederatorum Belgarum Senatus, qui Hagæ Comitis est, nuperrime membro, D. GUILJELMO van WEEDE, CONSVLIBVS; Nec non INCLYTO SENATUI Reipublicæ ULTRAJECTINÆ, ACADEMIÆ CURATORIBUS.

p.i: Uod fiat cum Vestra venia, ad Vos itur, Amplissimi Viri. Vobis enim, post Deum, primam reddere decet rationem otiorum, quæ nobis

page.notes: The opening word "Uod" is the woodcut initial Q of "Quod" with the initial letter lost in the illustration; read as printed. The title block is set in mixed roman, italic, capitals and small capitals; the first line is italic. The woodcut vignette at the left of the paragraph is an ornament, not text. The text "JCto" is printed with a superscript "to" and a comma.
